name: Football · World Cup
description: Recall who won every men's World Cup from 1930 to 2026, plus a few record-breaking facts about the tournament.

seals.title: World Champion
seals.note: Every World Cup winner, from 1930 to 2026, recalled.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Hosts; beat Argentina 4–2 in the final in Montevideo.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Came from a goal down to beat Czechoslovakia 2–1 in Rome.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Retained the title by beating Hungary 4–2 in the final.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat hosts Brazil 2–1 at the Maracanã in the decisive match.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat favourites Hungary 3–2 in Bern: the 'Miracle of Bern'.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat hosts Sweden 5–2; 17-year-old Pelé scored in all three knockouts.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat Czechoslovakia 3–1 in Santiago, retaining the title.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat West Germany 4–2 after extra time at Wembley.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat Italy 4–1 in Mexico City and kept the Jules Rimet Trophy.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat the Netherlands 2–1 in Munich, their second title.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat the Netherlands 3–1 after extra time; the hosts' first title.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat West Germany 3–1 in Madrid, their first title since 1938.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat West Germany 3–2 in Mexico City; Maradona captained the side.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat Argentina 1–0 in Rome, a rematch of the 1986 final.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat Italy 3–2 on penalties after a 0–0 draw in Pasadena.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat defending champions Brazil 3–0 at the Stade de France.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat Germany 2–0 in Yokohama; their fifth title.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat France 5–3 on penalties after a 1–1 draw in Berlin.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat the Netherlands 1–0 after extra time: their first title.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Mario Götze's extra-time goal beat Argentina 1–0 in Rio.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat Croatia 4–2 at the Luzhniki Stadium in Moscow.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat France on penalties after a 3–3 draw at Lusail Stadium.

cards.label: winner
cards.hook: Beat Argentina 1–0 after extra time in New Jersey: their second title.
